transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess what finally pushed me to come in is... I keep getting up during things. Like, important things. 

At work during sprint planning, or... even personal stuff, like mortgage calls. I know I should just stay put, but I'll suddenly decide I need water, or I need to check something in the other room, and I just get up. So... yeah. I'm just here about that.
Do you feel a sudden, strong urge or impulse that makes you get up, even when you know you shouldn't?

Yeah, I guess so. Um... it's just this... pressure. Even if I'm sitting there looking perfectly calm, inside it's like... I just need to move. Or do something with my hands, or switch tasks. It just gets to where I feel like I'm going to crawl out of my skin if I don't. So I just get up.
Do you often feel restless or find it hard to stay seated, even when you know you should?
Um... yeah. I think I just said that. It's... just that pressure inside. Like I need to move or do something with my hands, or I'll crawl out of my skin. Even if I look fine on the outside.
Do you find yourself feeling restless, impulsive, or having trouble focusing on tasks in other situations, like when you're at home or with friends?
Um... I don't know. I guess I haven't really thought about it outside of work. I mean, I'm just... busy at home. So I'm always doing something anyway. I don't really know about the focus part.
Can you think of times when you've felt that same inner pressure or restlessness outside of work—like when you're at home relaxing or spending time with friends?

I mean... I guess so. It's really just like I was saying before. Even if I'm at home on the couch and look like I'm just sitting there relaxing... I still get that same pressure inside. I just end up needing to mess with my hands or... get up and switch to a different task. It doesn't really go away.
Looking back, did you experience similar feelings of restlessness or difficulty staying seated as a child, or did these feelings start more recently in adulthood?

I guess it's been around for a while. Um... I remember in elementary school, my teachers would move my desk a lot. Or they were always telling me to sit down because I kept popping up out of my chair. And... I'd talk before they called on me, or just rush through my work, even if I knew how to do it. So... yeah, I suppose it's not new.
Do you often have trouble staying focused or find your mind wandering during tasks, even when you're trying to pay attention?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Sometimes. Like, if I'm trying to review a pull request at work... or, I don't know, reading over mortgage documents at home. I'll start out meaning to read it, but... then a few minutes go by and I'm just staring at the same paragraph. My mind is just... off on five other things. So, yeah, it wanders.
Do these feelings of restlessness, difficulty staying seated, and trouble focusing interfere with your ability to function well at work, at home, or in social situations?

I mean... yeah, a little bit. It's... there's been some friction lately. At work, and... at home, too. 

It just seems like people are having to follow up with me a lot more than they used to. And... I don't know, I just worry that I'm becoming the unreliable one when it comes to planning things. Even though I'm really trying hard to stay on top of it. So... yeah, I guess it does interfere.
Do you often find yourself fidgeting, tapping your hands or feet, or talking more than you intend to, especially when you're trying to stay still or quiet?

Um... I guess so. I mean, in meetings, I'm usually... bouncing my knee or clicking a pen. I don't really realize I'm doing it until... well, until someone looks over at me. And I shift around a lot. But... yeah, that's about it.
Do you often lose things you need for tasks or activities, like your keys, phone, or work materials, even when you know you should keep track of them?
Um... no, not really. I usually just... keep my phone and keys in the same spot. So... no, I don't think I lose things very often.
Do you often start tasks or projects but find yourself struggling to finish them because your mind drifts or you lose interest quickly?

I suppose... sometimes. Like, if my husband asks me to handle something with the insurance company... call them, upload a form, email the confirmation... I'll usually do the first part. But then... the last step just sort of sits there unfinished. At least until he reminds me.
Do you often find yourself interrupting others or blurting things out before they’ve finished speaking, even when you know you should wait your turn?

Um... I suppose so. Mostly at work. If a teammate is... explaining a bug or asking a question, I sometimes catch myself answering before they're done. And... well, sometimes I'm already talking when I realize I guessed wrong about where they were going with it. So... yeah, that happens.
Do you often find it hard to stay focused on what you're doing because your mind gets easily distracted by other things around you?
Um... no. Not that I've noticed. If I'm working, I usually just... put my headphones on and look at my screens. So... no, I don't think things around me pull my focus away much.
Do you often feel like you need to be moving or doing something physical, even in situations where most people would be able to sit still or relax?

Um... yeah, I guess. Even if it looks like I'm sitting calmly on the outside... inside there's this... pressure. Like I just need to move, or... switch to a different task, or do something with my hands. It just kind of builds up until I feel like I might crawl out of my skin. So... yes.
Can you think of any situations outside of work, like at home or in social settings, where you’ve felt a strong urge to interrupt others or act without thinking?
Um... I don't know. Not really, I guess. I mean... I mostly just keep to myself when I'm not at work. So... I don't really talk to that many people outside of that.
